categories.NAME: Select the correct label for a role/relationship/purpose defined by the text
categories.RETRIEVE: Locate explicitly stated information in the text
categories.INFER: Derive the conclusion that most logically follows from given premises
categories.VALIDATE: Select evidence that most directly supports or undermines a given claim
categories.RECONCILE: Identify how two texts' positions logically relate
categories.BUILD: Select from notes the sentence that achieves a stated rhetorical goal
categories.APPLY: Apply a grammar/punctuation rule to produce the correct form
